canonical_project: Noovle/TIM Turin data center (OCI eu-turin-1 host)
owner: TIM Enterprise / Noovle; Oracle OCI hosted
notes: TIM's Turin-area data center (Noovle-managed; baxtel lists Noovle Settimo Torinese-Cebrosa) hosts Oracle Cloud eu-turin-1 and is the Piedmont cloud-region seed. DCD reports Oracle is a client of TIM's Turin DC and that TIM (Oct 2025) announced a EUR 1bn 3-year plan to expand its Italian data center footprint. Oracle region page lists eu-turin-1 (Italy North, Turin) - A-grade regional availability, not a building address.
